segments.text: Queſt. 126. Which is the fifth Petition?

Anſ. " AND FORGIVE US OUR DEBTS, AS WE FORGIVE OUR DEBTORS;" that is, be pleaſed, for the Sake of Chriſt's Blood, not to impute to us poor Sinners, our Tranſgreſſions, nor that Depravity which always cleaves to us: even as we feel this Evidence of Thy Grace in us, that it is our firm Reſolution from the Heart to forgive our Neighbour.
